# Brunner Test - 3 Prongs for Student Loan Discharge [2026]
> Last updated: 2026-09-25

> The Brunner test (brunner test student loans, brunner test bankruptcy) determines if student loans are dischargeable in bankruptcy under 11 USC 523(a)(8).

## About
brunnertest.org is part of the Open Bankruptcy Project (openbankruptcyproject.org), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source tools for bankruptcy court transparency.
